program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id (lower Vgs -> tail headroom)
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # diff pair L (flicker area)
    "Itail": (32e-6, 20e-6, 50e-6),  # tail current
    "gmidp": (11.0, 8.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror load + output CS
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),
    "gmidn": (17.0, 12.0, 20.0),     # NMOS bias family (low vdsat)
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # long L -> high ro tail
    "I7":    (95e-6, 60e-6, 120e-6), # second stage current
    "Cc":    (1.1e-12, 0.6e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "kz":    (2.5, 1.2, 4.0),        # Rz = kz / gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.1)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6, vsb=vtail)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.1)

    mb0 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=vtail)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.7)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)

    gm6 = m6.gm
    Rz = p["kz"] / gm6

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m3.cgd
    Co = CL + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + Co * Cc + C1 * Co))
    zden = Rz - 1.0 / gm6
    zl = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * zden) if zden > 0 else 1e15
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / zl)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / (2 * fmir)))
    # CMRR: tail ro times mirror; derate by ~2.4x (mismatch / mirror pole) as seen in sim
    cmrr = A1 * 2 * m3.gm / m5.gds / 2.4
    psrr = A0 * 0.5
    power = vdd * (Iref + It + I7)
    slew = 0.7 * min(It / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))
    settle = 4.6 / (2 * PI * gbw) + 0.9 / slew
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th2 = 2 * 4 * kT * (2.0 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    W1 = m1.W; W3 = m3.W
    Kn, Kp = 4e-11, 1.5e-11          # rough flicker coeffs [V^2 um^2] at 1 Hz
    fl2 = 2 * (Kn / (W1 * p["L1"]) + Kp / (W3 * p["Lp"]) * (m3.gm / gm1) ** 2) / 1e3
    noise = math.sqrt(th2 + fl2)
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.08

    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "cmrr_db": db(cmrr), "psrr_db": db(psrr), "slew": slew,
               "settle": settle, "noise_1k": noise, "swing": swing}
